sources.quote: muru-D - Telstra Enterprise Publisher: Telstra Name: muru-D - Telstra Enterprise Copyrighted By: Telstra Family Friendly: Yes Language: English Skip to main content Telstra Personal Home Page Innovation happens here At muru-D, we turn 'what if' into 'what's next' by co-creating with our strategic partners and customers through exploration and incubation of new products, services and technologies. We're tackling some of the biggest problems the world faces today, one idea at a time. muru-D is Telstra's hub for incubating ideas, products, and technologies. The name muru-D has a meaningful origin rooted in the Sydney Aboriginal Eora language. The word 'muru' means path, symbolising a journey or direction. The 'D' stands for digital, representing the focus on digital innovation. Together, muru-D signifies a pathway to digital innovation. We explore new technologies and rapidly prototype solutions, drawing on our expertise in 5G, IoT, connectivity, edge computing, and applied AI. Partnering with industry, experts, and universities, we develop real-world solutions for real-world problems. Our process includes prototyping, proof-of-concepts, customer trials, and human-centred design workshops. We also support founders driving social technological impact and innovation in AI, VR, AR, drones, satellites, and robotics. Get in touch with muru-D
